title: Immediate danger
content: If you feel in immediate danger, move toward a safer populated place when possible, tell a trusted person, and use a locally verified emergency resource appropriate to your location.

title: OTP safety
content: Never share an OTP, verification code, PIN, or password with someone who asks unexpectedly. Legitimate support should not need your one-time code.

title: Suspicious links
content: Do not click a suspicious link. Instead, independently open the organization's known website or app and check for alerts there.

title: Phishing basics
content: Phishing commonly uses urgency, fear, rewards, impersonation, or requests for credentials and payments. Pause and verify through an independent channel.

title: Suspicious messages
content: Preserve suspicious messages and sender details, avoid replying or clicking links, and independently verify unusual requests.

title: Online harassment
content: For online harassment, preserve original messages and timestamps, use platform blocking/reporting tools where appropriate, and tell a trusted person. For formal reporting, verify the current process for your jurisdiction.

title: Complaint preparation
content: Prepare a factual timeline, dates, approximate times, locations or platforms, relevant accounts, witnesses if known, and original evidence. Do not fabricate details.

title: Privacy
content: Use unique passwords, multi-factor authentication where available, review privacy settings, and avoid sharing sensitive personal information publicly.

title: Evidence preservation
content: Keep original screenshots, messages, URLs, emails, files, and transaction records. Avoid editing the originals; keep a backup in a secure place.

title: Unsafe situations
content: If a situation feels unsafe, prioritize physical safety, seek support from someone you trust, and avoid escalating confrontation when leaving or getting help is safer.
